Former Pitcher, Oakland A's Legend
mid-career

Now: Former Pitcher, Oakland A's Legend; retired C116. Born 2005, Oakland native. Starting pitcher (left-handed), Oakland Athletics. 5x Cy Young Award winner. Farewell season in 2041 — age 38, velocity in honest conversation with the calendar. Part of the Dynasty Five farewell alongside Kelley and Keane. Married. Hal Richmond: "Dillon is intelligence." Sat courtside at Chase Center with Aitken, Keane, and Mike Paulson for a Warriors game — standing ovation. Accompanied Aitken to the DEIR civic session. Lives in Rockridge. The kind of pitcher whose declining velocity is a story every reporter wants to write but nobody wants to be right about.
